result: Replace the descending `if/else` priority chain that assigns `index_reg` with explicit winner terms: each request bit wins only when set and every higher-priority bit is clear, then OR the winning terms into the three encoded index bits. Keep the `valid_reg <= |request` reduction, synchronous active-high reset, registered outputs, exact one-cycle behavior, and the top module’s `// @latency 1` annotation. Preserve index zero for an all-zero request and highest-set-bit priority for every nonzero pattern; this is an area hypothesis, so retain the candidate only if all gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below 6.
